meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 装了它之后，你说要扩展或修改 NanoClaw（比如加新消息渠道或改触发词），Claude 会先反问你几个细节，再调用现成的定制命令或直接改配置，改完告诉你如何重启生效。
howto.when: 当你提出想添加新的消息入口（如 Telegram 等）、修改触发条件、接入外部工具或做其他定制时，它会接管。

say.text: 我想把 Telegram 作为新的输入渠道接入 NanoClaw。
say.note: 会先问你接到哪个现有助手组还是新建一个。

say.text: 把某频道的触发词改成含“日报”就唤醒。
say.note: 会定位对应频道的触发规则来修改。

say.text: 给助手增加一个 Google 日历读取工具。
say.note: 如有现成安装技能会优先调用它。

howto.what_en: When installed, if the user asks to extend or tweak NanoClaw, Claude first asks clarifying questions, then runs a ready-made install command or edits config accordingly, and tells the user how to rebuild/restart afterwards.
howto.when_en: Use this when the user wants to add an input channel (e.g. Telegram, Slack), change triggers, add integrations, modify routing, or make any other NanoClaw customization.

say_en.text: I want Telegram to become a new input channel for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: It asks whether to connect to an existing agent group or create a new one.

say_en.text: Make a certain channel's trigger include the word 'daily'.
say_en.note: It will locate and update that channel's trigger rules.

say_en.text: Add a read-only Google Calendar tool to the assistant.
say_en.note: Uses the ready-made installation skill if there is one.
